requirements.requirement: Final report separates scientific conclusions, engineering failures, proxy distortion, and untested hypotheses.
The selected algorithm has proposal-only, observable-only and projected/full ablation evidence rather than definitions alone.
requirements.boundary: Every credible frontier algorithm first receives its own full e200 trajectory; the canonical primary then receives source-bound long-horizon ablations. Definitions and ready adjudication code are not accepted as experimental results. Observable-only must match plain at e200 for the complete next-update dynamics state (networks, optimizers, schedulers, method state, RNG and both samplers), while identity-only metadata is excluded. Projected/full reuses the selected source-bound e200 receipt; proposal-only then observable-only run as two sequential single-stream e200 trajectories. If PCNR or AM-MCRB wins a 4090 replay, its own ablations are mandatory and PC-RSMG evidence cannot be substituted. Under the explicit emergency protocol, a proposal-only challenger may replace full by the complete seed2026/e200 posthoc rank; the delivery must state that seed2027/2028 are deferred and cross-seed stability is not established.
